description: Mandibuzz-centered team where an electric type (Morpeko) pairs with the flying Mandibuzz to cover ground threats, with Sableye added to avoid being overly vulnerable to electric. Morpeko runs Seed Bomb over Psychic Fang so it can beat Quagsire.
performanceNotes: Electric + flying duo covers ground while Mandibuzz walls ground types
Seed Bomb Morpeko removes Quagsire as a counter
Sableye reduces electric vulnerability and destroys Annihilape
